title: Rank compatibility for clopen restrictions of finite etale morphisms
statement: Let $q:X\to S$ be finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] and let $(j:X_0\to X,q_0:X_0\to S_0,q,i:S_0\to S)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $W\subseteq X$ be open [def-weil-open-immersion] and closed. Then both $q|_W:W\to S$ and $q_0|_{j^{-1}W}:j^{-1}W\to S_0$ are finite etale. For each $x\in S_0$, the rank of the second morphism at $x$ equals the rank of the first at $i(x)$, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-flat-rank-iso].

source.place: finrank_of_isPullback (165–170), Restrict.lean isPullback_morphismRestrict (586); corrected blueprint finite-etale lifting steps 3 and 5

proof.text: The inclusion of W is an open immersion and has closed image, hence a closed immersion (IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion, ClosedImmersion.lean:65, using Opens.range_ι). It is therefore finite, and also etale. The same applies to j inverse image W, whose closedness follows by continuity. The base change q0 is finite etale; composition gives both claimed properties.

The inverse-image open square is cartesian by [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product]. Paste it vertically with the given square by [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting]. The resulting square has vertical maps precisely the two restricted projections. Apply the rank base-change equality in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-flat-rank-iso].

lean.statement: theorem Scheme.finiteEtale_clopen_restriction_rank {X X₀ S S₀ : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ S) [IsFinite q] [Etale q] (j : X₀ ⟶ X) (q₀ : X₀ ⟶ S₀) (i : S₀ ⟶ S) (h : IsPullback j q₀ q i) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsClosed (W : Set X)) : IsFinite (W.ι ≫ q) ∧ Etale (W.ι ≫ q) ∧ IsFinite ((j ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ q₀) ∧ Etale ((j ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ q₀) ∧ ∀ x : S₀, (((j ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ q₀).finrank x) = (W.ι ≫ q).finrank (i x)
